title: The Governor
quote: Art. 142 granted deemed assent (Apr 2025); the Art. 143 Reference rejected it (Nov 2025)

boxes.title: Office & appointment
items: **Art. 153**: one per State; same person for two or more States (==**7th Amendment, 1956**==)
**Art. 154**: executive power; **Art. 168**: part of State Legislature
**Art. 155**: appointed by **President** by warrant under hand and seal
**Art. 157-158**: citizen, ==**35** years==, not MP/MLA, no office of profit
**Art. 159**: oath by **Chief Justice of the High Court**
**Art. 156**: **pleasure of the President**; **5 years** but continues until successor
**Art. 202**: emoluments charged on **Consolidated Fund of the State**
**Art. 361**: no criminal proceedings; civil only after **2 months'** notice

boxes.title: Bills: Art. 200 → 201
steps: Mandatory reservation: bill derogating from **High Court** powers
President (Art. 201): assent, withhold or return; legislature reconsiders in **6 months**; ==absolute veto==

items.what: **Punjab**: act "as soon as possible"; re-passed bill gets assent
**TN v Governor**: **1 / 3 / 1 month** limits; **Art 142** deemed assent to **10** bills
**16th Reference (Art 143)**: ==no court timelines, deemed assent rejected==; limited mandamus

cards.title: Shamsher Singh (1974)
lines: **7** judges; bound by aid and advice

cards.title: B.P. Singhal (2010)
lines: Removal not **arbitrary**; not for change at Centre

boxes.title: President's Rule (Art. 356)
items: On **Governor's report** or suo motu; **6 months** at a time, max ==**3 years**==
Beyond **1 year**: National Emergency **+** EC certificate (44th Amendment)
Never in **Telangana**, **Chhattisgarh**; most in **Manipur** (**13 Feb 2025** → revoked **4 Feb 2026**)
